resources.string: Only inside Xiaomi GetApps, spoof the device as Xiaomi 18 Pro Max (madrid / 2611FPNFAG). Does not change global system properties.

This is a modern LSPosed module (libxposed API 102).

Enable it in LSPosed, keep the recommended scope as com.xiaomi.market only, then force-stop Xiaomi GetApps.

It rewrites Build fields and SystemProperties reads inside the store process. It does not change getprop for the rest of the phone.
